# unifi_map (Resource)

The `unifi_map` resource manages a map (floor plan) in the UniFi controller. Maps provide the spatial backdrop used to place devices and overlay heat maps (`unifi_heat_map`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_map" "example" {
  name        = "ground-floor"
  type        = "imageMap"
  unit        = "m"
  opacity     = 0.8
  offset_left = 0
  offset_top  = 0
  upp         = 1.0
  zoom        = 18
  selected    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `lat` (String) The latitude of the map centre (used by Google maps).
- `lng` (String) The longitude of the map centre (used by Google maps).
- `map_type_id` (String) The Google map type. One of `satellite`, `roadmap`, `hybrid` or `terrain`.
- `name` (String) The name of the map.
- `offset_left` (Number) The horizontal offset of the map image, in pixels.
- `offset_top` (Number) The vertical offset of the map image, in pixels.
- `opacity` (Number) The opacity of the map image, between `0` and `1`.
- `selected` (Boolean) Whether this map is the currently selected map.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `tilt` (Number) The tilt angle of the map, in degrees.
- `type` (String) The type of map. One of `designerMap`, `imageMap` or `googleMap`.
- `unit` (String) The distance unit of the map. One of `m` (metric) or `f` (imperial).
- `upp` (Number) The units-per-pixel scale of the map.
- `zoom` (Number) The zoom level of the map.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import from provider configured site
terraform import unifi_map.example 5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217

# import from another site
terraform import unifi_map.example another-site:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
